title: Descent of the underlying finite etale stalk model
statement: Let S be a Noetherian quasi-separated scheme and c:C\to S a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism locally of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let s\in S and let Q be a finite etale cover of C_s^{loc}=C\times_S Spec O_{S,s} [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-pc-fibre-product]. There exist an open neighbourhood W of s, a finite etale cover R of C_W=c^{-1}(W), and a map l:C_s^{loc}\to C_W such that l followed by the open inclusion equals the canonical projection C_s^{loc}\to C, and l^*R is isomorphic to Q. No cover on another open and no comparison on an overlap are part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Use the affine-neighbourhood limit theorem to obtain nonemptiness, directedness, compatible canonical projections, and unique factorization. Form the diagram of affine open subschemes, reindex by the opposite of its order dual, and build its limit cone from the unique-factorization clause. Base change by c; use Mathlib isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected and isPullback_pullback_map to prove the resulting cone is a limit. Its stages are qcqs by base change of the qcqs morphism c over affine schemes; its transition maps are affine by base change of maps between affine schemes.

Apply exists_isPullback_of_finitePresentation in the main theorem to descend Q to an explicitly chosen finitely presented qcqs cartesian model at stage i. Apply the proved private exists_finiteEtale_refinement to this model: transport finiteness and etaleness to its limit pullback, apply the existing finite and etale property-descent declarations separately, and take a directed common refinement r with i <= r. Mathlib MorphismProperty.of_isPullback transports each property to r. Pullback lifting and IsPullback.of_right construct the refined cartesian model. This helper only refines a supplied model, rather than repeating the library's combined object-and-property descent theorem.

Identify the selected pullback stage with the preimage open in C by Mathlib isPullback_morphismRestrict. Compose the limit projection with the inverse of this identification to construct l, and use pullback projection equations to prove the required composite equality. Transport the descended structure map across the same isomorphism, package it using Etale.mk, and lift the inverse cartesian comparison to the finite etale full subcategory using MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk and ObjectProperty.isoMk.

lean.statement:
theorem FiniteEtale.exists_stalk_neighbourhood_model {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation c]
    (s : S) (Q : (Limits.pullback c (S.fromSpecStalk s)).FiniteEtale) :
    ∃ (W : S.Opens), s ∈ W ∧
      ∃ (R : (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
        (l : Limits.pullback c (S.fromSpecStalk s) ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme),
        l ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s) ∧
          Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback l).obj R ≅ Q)
